name: audit-auth-session-management
description: Audits authentication and session management for password handling, MFA, session cookies, JWT validation, OAuth/OIDC/SAML flows, account recovery, brute force protection, credential stuffing defenses, and authentication failure handling.
instructions:
# audit-auth-session-management

Audits authentication and session controls for account compromise and session takeover risks.

## Orchestration

1. Load `references/rules.yaml` to get the active `ASM-` rule set.
2. Load `../_shared/owasp-cheatsheets.yaml` and use the mapped OWASP cheat sheets to support remediation guidance and references.
3. Identify target evidence from source code, configuration, tests, API specs, IaC, CI/CD, runtime manifests, and documentation relevant to the request.
4. Evaluate each rule using its `match_strategy`, preserving file path, line, snippet, control context, and confidence.
5. Mark each rule `Pass`, `Fail`, `Partial`, `Unknown`, or `Not Applicable` based on available evidence.
6. Prioritize findings by severity, exploitability, exposed surface, and whether a concrete remediation is available.
7. Render the final report using `references/report-template.md`.

## Usage

Scan the current repository:

```text
/audit-auth-session-management
```

Scan a specific path:

```text
/audit-auth-session-management src/ services/ docs/
```

## OWASP Cheat Sheets

Use the shared mapping in `../_shared/owasp-cheatsheets.yaml` for authoritative OWASP Cheat Sheet Series references that match this skill. Include the relevant cheat sheet links in the report when they directly support a finding or remediation.

## Review Guidance

Prioritize credential handling, MFA bypass, weak session cookies, JWT verification, OAuth redirect handling, and recovery flows.

rules.name: Detect weak password storage
rules.description: Identify plaintext, reversible, unsalted, or fast-hash password storage.
rules.remediation: Use Argon2id, bcrypt, scrypt, or PBKDF2 with strong parameters and per-user salts.

rules.name: Detect missing MFA for sensitive actions
rules.description: Identify admin, payment, account recovery, and high-risk actions without MFA or step-up auth.
rules.remediation: Require MFA or step-up authentication for privileged and sensitive operations.

rules.name: Detect insecure session cookie flags
rules.description: Identify missing Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite, or overly broad Domain/Path attributes.
rules.remediation: Set Secure, HttpOnly, appropriate SameSite, narrow Domain/Path, and short session lifetimes.

rules.name: Detect unsafe JWT validation
rules.description: Identify disabled signature verification, alg confusion, missing issuer/audience/expiry checks.
rules.remediation: Verify signature, algorithm, issuer, audience, expiry, not-before, and key rotation.

rules.name: Detect unsafe redirect URI handling
rules.description: Identify wildcard or user-controlled redirect URIs and weak state/nonce handling.
rules.remediation: Require exact redirect URI matching and validate state and nonce.

rules.name: Detect missing login throttling
rules.description: Identify login endpoints without rate limits, lockout, bot defenses, or anomaly detection.
rules.remediation: Add adaptive throttling, monitoring, and safe account lockout or challenge flows.

rules.name: Detect missing breached-password defenses
rules.description: Identify lack of breached password checks or impossible-travel/anomaly monitoring.
rules.remediation: Check new passwords against breach corpuses and monitor credential stuffing patterns.

rules.name: Detect weak password reset flows
rules.description: Identify reset tokens without expiry, replay protection, randomness, or account takeover safeguards.
rules.remediation: Use high-entropy single-use reset tokens, short expiry, and notification of recovery events.

rules.name: Detect missing session rotation after login or privilege change
rules.description: Identify sessions not regenerated after authentication or privilege elevation.
rules.remediation: Rotate session IDs after login, MFA, password change, and role elevation.

rules.name: Detect incomplete logout and revocation
rules.description: Identify logout flows that do not invalidate server-side sessions or refresh tokens.
rules.remediation: Invalidate sessions and refresh tokens server-side and clear client cookies.

rules.name: Detect unsafe SAML assertions
rules.description: Identify missing signature validation, audience checks, replay protection, or weak XML parser config.
rules.remediation: Validate signatures, issuer, audience, time windows, and disable unsafe XML processing.

rules.name: Detect authentication enumeration
rules.description: Identify login, reset, or registration responses that reveal account existence.
rules.remediation: Return consistent responses and log detailed reasons server-side.
